name: skills_disable
description: Turns one skill off on one computer or workspace by its name, as the login it was added with: its SKILL.md is renamed SKILL.md.off in each folder it really lives in, which every link to it follows, and no agent config is edited. A project's skill lives in the repo and is refused. The skill wsp writes and a plugin's are always on and are refused; a napping workspace is not woken. The report there reads again at once.

name.description: the skill's name, as skills lists it

workspace.description: the workspace to read, by its name, or its id when two share a name; absent reads a computer

on.description: the computer to read, by the name computers lists; absent with no workspace is the computer the app runs on
